review_notes.review_scope: Entire rendered answer and source descriptions reviewed. Retained independent substantive assertions and experimental tuples; repeated core-claim summaries, duplicate numerical restatements, source labels, editorial planning, suggested followups, confidence and deterministic ledgers excluded. Mixed paragraphs split where practical; localized error is identified when a compound unit remains.

claims.text: - **Central value:** The measurements cluster tightly around **≈ 75.3 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹** (equivalently **≈ 4.18 J·K⁻¹·g⁻¹** or **≈ 1.00 cal·K⁻¹·g⁻¹** when converted using the molar mass of water, 18.015 g/mol).
claims.reason: Descriptive central value and mass-specific/calorie conversions are correct; this is a practical summary, not a fitted uncertainty.

evidence.assessment: Descriptive central value and mass-specific/calorie conversions are correct; this is a practical summary, not a fitted uncertainty.

evidence.scope: Background only; never substituted for an original ThermoML measurement.

claims.text: - **Pressure conditions:** All blocks with temperature as the sole variable imply a fixed (atmospheric) pressure; the one block that explicitly records pressure (DOI: 10.1016/j.jct.2016.09.031) confirms **101.325 kPa** exactly.
claims.reason: Temperature-only variables do not imply atmospheric pressure. Other listed blocks have explicit fixed pressure constraints100,101or101.325 kPa; only one pressure-specified source is false.

evidence.assessment: Temperature-only variables do not imply atmospheric pressure. Other listed blocks have explicit fixed pressure constraints100,101or101.325 kPa; only one pressure-specified source is false.

claims.text: Water's unusually high heat capacity — compared to most liquids — arises from its extensive hydrogen-bonding network: thermal energy is absorbed not only by molecular translations and rotations but also by the continuous breaking and reorganizing of hydrogen bonds.
claims.reason: Generic high water heatcapacity and hydrogen-bond network contribution are physically sound when high is understood on the customary mass-specific basis.

evidence.assessment: Generic high water heatcapacity and hydrogen-bond network contribution are physically sound when high is understood on the customary mass-specific basis.
